defaultValue:
Switch off any of these modules you do not want. A change takes effect the next time you start a new game or load a save.

Switching a module off never deletes anything from your saves, and switching it back on picks up where it left off. [Cloning] and [Rev. Eng. Private Arsenal] buildings you already have keep working while their module is off; only new ones can no longer be built.

StopBloatingMe, StopStackingMe, Intel Renewed, Hullmods - Renewed and StarterPack are always on. They only do what you set up in them, and their own tabs control that.

The first time the pack starts, it copies over your settings from the separate versions of these mods.

defaultValue: When you hold more than one of something, the game normally draws its sprite once per unit, piled up behind the first one. These toggles make it draw a single sprite instead. The quantity number in the corner is untouched, so you can still see how many you have. Changes apply the next time a screen draws - no restart needed.

fieldDescription: Applies to weapons everywhere they are shown as a stack: the cargo screen, trading, storage, loot, and the weapon picker in refit.

fieldName: Crew and marines - one sprite only
fieldDescription: Crew and marine stacks pile up the same way, one extra portrait for every 50 aboard. Turn this on to flatten those too.

When on, an entry you have hidden (its kind, its category, or the entry itself) no longer shows the message popup in the bottom-left corner. Turn this off to keep the popups while the entries stay hidden on the intel screen.
With this on, [Shift + right-click] on a row in the intel list hides that one entry, and [Ctrl + right-click] hides every entry of the same kind. Turn it off if it clashes with another mod.

How solid the Customize window's black background is. [0] is fully transparent, [1] is fully opaque.

defaultValue: Hidden kinds and hidden categories are stored once per installation, in [saves/common/intel_renewed/], so they carry over to every playthrough. Single entries you hide are stored in that save only. Nothing is ever deleted from the game: hidden entries are only kept off the screen and can be brought back from the Customize window on the intel screen.

fieldDescription: Turn this on and press [Apply] to erase every hidden kind and category and start from an empty slate. Entries hidden per save are not affected. This cannot be undone. The toggle resets itself to off once the wipe has run, so it will read as off again the next time you open this menu.

defaultValue: These decide what the filter panel's toggles start at, and what [Reset filters] puts them back to. Changing one here applies it to the open picker right away; your other filters are left alone.

fieldDescription: Hides hull-mods that can never go on the ship being refitted (a carrier mod on a hull with no bays). Turn this off if you would rather always see the full list.
Starts the picker showing only the hull-mods you have favourited. Holding [`] (backtick) does this momentarily regardless of the setting.
Starts the picker with hidden (blacklisted) hull-mods revealed instead of filtered out. Holding [Alt] does this momentarily regardless of the setting.

fieldName: Also search descriptions - on by default
fieldDescription: Widens the search box to match each hull-mod's description text, not just its name and design type.

defaultValue: Your favourites, hidden hull-mods, custom-group membership and group names are stored once per installation, in [saves/common/hullmods_renewed/], so they carry over to every playthrough. Marks for hull-mods you have not learned yet - or that belong to a mod you have disabled - are kept as-is and start working again as soon as those mods show up.
